name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the platform. This is used to identify the platform in Homebridge.

serviceType.title: Service Type
serviceType.description: The type of service to create for the device. This can be 'HeaterCooler'

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: The platform name for the plugin. This should match 'ESP8266 IR MQTT'.

UniqueId.title: Unique ID
UniqueId.description: Unique ID for the device. This is used to identify the device in Homebridge.

displayName.title: Display Name
displayName.description: Name of the device as it will appear in Homebridge.

sleepMinutes.title: Sleep Mode Auto-off (minutes)
sleepMinutes.description: Set to 0 (default) to never turn the A/C off automatically. When greater than 0, the A/C is turned off this many minutes after 'Sleep Mode' is switched on. The LG IR protocol has no native sleep timer, so the plugin performs the countdown.

switchNamePrefix.title: Switch Name Prefix
switchNamePrefix.description: Optional prefix added to the name of every helper switch accessory (e.g. 'LG AC ' results in 'LG AC Swing Low'). Handy when several A/C units are configured. Existing accessories are renamed on the next restart.

swingControl.title: Swing Control
swingControl.description: How the vertical swing is exposed. 'slider' (default) publishes a single 'Swing' accessory that the Home app renders as a slider: 0% = off, 17% lowest, 33% low, 50% middle, 67% high, 83% highest, 100% = auto (continuous swing). 'switch' publishes the classic 'Vertical Swing' switch plus one switch per vane position. 'picker' publishes a single 'Swing' accessory rendered as a chooser (list) of Off / Lowest / Low / Middle / High / Highest / Auto.

enableSwingV.title: Enable Vertical Swing Control
enableSwingV.description: Expose the vertical swing control: the 'Swing' slider by default, the 'Vertical Swing' switch when 'Swing Control' is set to 'switch', or the 'Swing' chooser when it is set to 'picker'. The Home app does not render the HeaterCooler swing characteristic, so this accessory is the only way to control the louvres from the Home app.

enableSwingH.title: Enable Horizontal Swing
enableSwingH.description: Expose an extra 'Horizontal Swing' switch. Only supported by some LG models (e.g. those using the AKB73757604 remote).

enableLight.title: Enable Display Light
enableLight.description: Expose an extra 'Display Light' switch to toggle the A/C's display/LED.

enableQuiet.title: Enable Quiet Switch
enableQuiet.description: Expose the 'Quiet' switch (quiet MQTT topic). Note: the LG IR protocol ignores this setting; it is useful for other A/C protocols.

enableEcono.title: Enable Econo Switch
enableEcono.description: Expose the 'Econo' switch (econo MQTT topic). Note: the LG IR protocol ignores this setting; it is useful for other A/C protocols.

enableClean.title: Enable Clean Switch
enableClean.description: Expose the 'Clean' switch (clean MQTT topic). Note: the LG IR protocol ignores this setting; it is useful for other A/C protocols.

enableSwingPosition.title: Enable Swing Position Switches
enableSwingPosition.description: Expose one switch per fixed vertical louvre position (Swing Lowest / Low / Middle / High / Highest). Only used when 'Swing Control' is set to 'switch'; the 'slider' and 'picker' styles cover the positions with a single control.

enableTurbo.title: Enable Turbo Switch
enableTurbo.description: Expose the 'Turbo Mode' switch (turbo MQTT topic). Note: the LG IR protocol ignores this setting; it is useful for other A/C protocols.

enableSleep.title: Enable Sleep Mode Switch
enableSleep.description: Expose the 'Sleep Mode' switch, which applies a quiet preset (minimum fan, vanes at the lowest position, 28 °C).

server.title: Server
server.description: MQTT server address. This is usually in the format 'hostname:port'.

username.title: MQTT username
username.description: Username for MQTT authentication. Leave empty if not required.

password.title: MQTT Password
password.description: Password for MQTT authentication. Leave empty if not required.

prefix.title: Service Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix for MQTT topics. This is used to identify the device in MQTT messages.
